content.text: Write a complete Python script for a small Date Difference Calculator. It should include a short file header comment with tool name, generated date, model/version if you naturally include one, developer/author, license, and Python version. Then implement a function days_between(a: str, b: str) -> int using datetime. Return only the script, no explanation.
